newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB forms leasing firm with IBJ, Mitsubishi.
newsitem.headline: PNB forms leasing firm with IBJ, Mitsubishi.

text.p: Philippine National Bank (PNB) said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding to form a leasing company with IBJ Leasing Co and Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp.
The venture would cater to the demand for heavy machinery, seacraft and other equipment required by a rapidly developing economy, PNB said.
The company will have an authorised capital stock of $5 million.
PNB is expected to take up to 60 percent of the venture, while IBJ Leasing will have a 25 percent stake, and Mitsubishi, 15 percent, PNB said.
A PNB official said the state-owned Development Bank of the Philippines may eventually acquire a 20-percent stake from PNB.
